title: Sweden's right wing struggles to make most of late rebound on eve of elections

title: 25 French jihadists held in Iraq appeal to EU human rights court for repatriation
subhead: The Islamic State group members had been quietly transferred from Syria to Iraq, where they could face the death penalty. Their lawyers say Paris's refusal to prosecute them in France undermines the rule of law and opens to arbitrary decisions by the authorities.

title: The forgotten French prisoner of 9/11
subhead: Zacarias Moussaoui, who was sent to the US by Al-Qaeda to prepare attacks and was convicted of complicity in the September 11 attacks, has spent the past 20 years serving a life sentence without the possibility of parole in a high-security penitentiary in Colorado. His lawyer is requesting his transfer to France.

title: Céline Dion's Paris residency brings economic boost: 'When you're a fan, money is no object'
subhead: After six years away from the stage, the Québécois superstar begins a run of 26 concerts in Paris on Saturday. Hoteliers, restaurateurs and retailers hope to benefit from the influx of nearly 800,000 fans, both French and international. The windfall is estimated at between €500 million and €1 billion, but it comes at a climate cost.
